name: event-timer
description: Standalone event timer for Windows and macOS
author: mirslava88

scripts.package:win: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.intel.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:intel: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.intel.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:catalina: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.catalina.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.m.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:m: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.m.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64:dir: npm run icon && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac dir --x64 --publish never
